responsibility: Declares the large family of interner-dependent capability traits that emulate the inherent methods available on rustc’s concrete type-system values in an interner-agnostic setting. It specifies the common APIs for types, consts, regions, predicates, clauses, generic-argument lists, defs, parameter environments, placeholders, spans, and related slice-like containers so the rest of the crate can manipulate type IR uniformly across interners.
